# cato_mailing_list (Resource)

Manages one mailing list and its complete address and administrator membership. Creating a mailing list does not send notifications. Import using its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Owns the entire mailing list membership; creating it sends no email.
resource "cato_mailing_list" "example" {
  name    = "Operations"
  address = ["operations@example.com"]
  # Admin references require IDs. Names are returned for display only.
  # admin = [{ id = "123" }]
}

# At least one address or administrator must remain.
# terraform import cato_mailing_list.example 12345
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name

### Optional

- `address` (Set of String) Email addresses. Removing this attribute clears all addresses.
- `admin` (Attributes Set) Administrator IDs with computed display names. Name-only references are unsupported. Removing this attribute clears administrators; at least one address or administrator is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--admin))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID

<a id="nestedatt--admin"></a>
### Nested Schema for `admin`

Optional:

- `id` (String) Administrator ID
- `name` (String) Administrator name
